events.name: Paint
events.description: Raised when the panel needs to be drawn.
events.argumentsNote: e.Graphics is the surface to draw on and e.ClipRectangle is the area that needs repainting.
events.useCase: Draw a custom border, gradient or line on the panel.

events.name: Resize
events.description: Raised when the panel is resized.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Re-center a child control when the panel changes size.

events.name: ControlAdded
events.description: Raised after a control is added to the panel's Controls collection.
events.argumentsNote: e.Control is the control that was added.
events.useCase: Apply common settings to every control added at run time.

events.name: Enter
events.description: Raised when focus moves into the group box or one of the controls inside it.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Highlight the group the user is working in.

events.name: Paint
events.description: Raised when the group box is drawn.
events.argumentsNote: e.Graphics is the surface to draw on.
events.useCase: Add a custom outline or decoration.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.description: Raised after the selected tab has changed.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Show the name of the current page or load its data.

events.name: Selecting
events.description: Raised before a different tab is selected.
events.argumentsNote: e.TabPage and e.TabPageIndex identify the tab being selected, e.Action says how, and e.Cancel = true stops the switch.
events.useCase: Block access to a tab until the user has the right to see it.

events.name: Selected
events.description: Raised after a tab has been selected.
events.argumentsNote: e.TabPage and e.TabPageIndex identify the tab that was selected.
events.useCase: Load the contents of a page only when it is first shown.

events.name: Deselecting
events.description: Raised before the current tab is left.
events.argumentsNote: e.TabPage is the tab being left. Set e.Cancel = true to keep it selected.
events.useCase: Validate the page and stop the user from leaving if it is invalid.

events.name: Enter
events.description: Raised when focus enters the page, usually after its tab is selected.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Put the focus on the first field of the page.

events.name: Leave
events.description: Raised when focus leaves the page.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Save the page's settings when the user goes to another tab.

events.name: SplitterMoved
events.description: Raised after the user has moved the splitter.
events.argumentsNote: e.SplitX and e.SplitY are the splitter position, e.X and e.Y the mouse position.
events.useCase: Remember the splitter position so it can be restored next time.

events.name: SplitterMoving
events.description: Raised while the user drags the splitter, before it moves.
events.argumentsNote: e.SplitX and e.SplitY are the proposed splitter position. Set e.Cancel = true to refuse the move.
events.useCase: Keep a panel from becoming too small.

events.name: ControlAdded
events.description: Raised after a control is added to the panel.
events.argumentsNote: e.Control is the control that was added.
events.useCase: Give every new item the same margin.

events.name: ControlRemoved
events.description: Raised after a control is removed from the panel.
events.argumentsNote: e.Control is the control that was removed.

events.name: CellPaint
events.description: Raised for each cell when the table is drawn.
events.argumentsNote: e.Row and e.Column identify the cell, e.CellBounds is its rectangle, e.Graphics the surface.
events.useCase: Shade the header row or alternate rows.
